headline: North Florida goes unbeaten against its own conference
dek: The only points North Florida dropped to a conference side all season came in a goalless draw at Bellarmine. Luciano Natoli kept seven shutouts behind thirteen wins, and the side's latest match, away to Vermont, was a defeat.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: North Florida turned 30 goals into thirteen wins, more wins than any other programme: the bars sit close together, and the most wins did not come from the most goals.

wire.line: North Florida went the season without losing to a conference rival, then lost at Vermont.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Twelve August matches are past their date with no result; Stetson, Lipscomb, Queens, FGCU and Bellarmine each have at least one among them.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Lipscomb finished with three wins and twelve defeats, more defeats than any other programme.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Queens conceded 42 goals, more than any other programme, against 31 scored.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Bellarmine conceded fourteen goals on a record of seven wins, five draws and four defeats.

last_match.line: North Florida's first defeat since losing at FIU in early October.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
